Class GLInterfaceCommon

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.opengl.GLInterfaceCommon
Direct Known Subclasses:
GLInterface
public abstract class GLInterfaceCommon extends Object
OpenGL 3.1 Core and OpenGL ES 3.0 have a common subset.

No javadoc here, please refer to LWJGL javadoc and OpenGL specification.
